knowledge.title: Logical service and instance identity
knowledge.application_limit: Do not merge different namespaces or infer that two records came from the same replica from service.name alone.
knowledge.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
knowledge.text: service.name identifies a logical service; service.namespace disambiguates groups. service.instance.id distinguishes its running instances. Several replicas may share one service.name.

knowledge.title: Service version is a separate attribute
knowledge.application_limit: A source commit and a telemetry service-name match do not establish deployed-source equality.
knowledge.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
knowledge.text: service.version describes the component version, and its format is not standardized. The logical service name alone does not identify the version.

knowledge.title: Error classification depends on the operation
knowledge.application_limit: This development guidance is interpretation context, not a guarantee that historical instrumentation complied with it.
knowledge.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
knowledge.text: An error code needs operation context: even HTTP 404 may be expected when checking existence. Current guidance says handled or retried errors should not mark an overall operation as failed when it completes gracefully.

knowledge.title: Log timestamps and optional trace fields
knowledge.application_limit: Keep event time distinct from collection time. Similar wording or nearby timestamps alone do not establish a shared request.
knowledge.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
knowledge.text: Timestamp records when an event occurred; ObservedTimestamp records when collection observed it. TraceId and SpanId are optional correlation fields. Resource identifies the source entity; Body and Attributes carry event content.
